title: VCPS gate evaluation record
description: Structural schema for .vcps/gates/GATE-*.md frontmatter. Owned in content by standard/gates/README.md SS6 (VCPS-GATE-050). NEW_CANONICAL_RECONSTRUCTION authored 2026-10-06; see evaluation/completion-roadmap.md Phase B.

revision.description: The exact evaluated revision (VCPS-GATE-030: Gates 4/5 MUST be on a recorded revision).

change_class.description: Null only for SETUP or read-only AUDIT scope, per templates/contract.md ('SETUP and read-only AUDIT MUST record their scope rather than invent a change class'). This is an immutable evaluation snapshot (VCPS-CORE ownership table), not the work item's current class.

scope_description.description: Required when change_class is null: what was actually evaluated (a SETUP stage, an AUDIT boundary) instead of a change.

project_level.description: Immutable evaluation-time snapshot; current level is owned by project.yaml.

reason_codes.description: Required, non-empty, when outcome is BLOCKED (gates/README.md SS2).

partial_gap.description: Required when outcome is PARTIAL: the explicitly recorded gap (VCPS-GATE-010).

applicability_basis.description: Required when outcome is NOT_APPLICABLE: the matrix row and facts that make it apply (VCPS-GATE-002).

independence_mode.description: Required (non-null) for Gates 4 and 5 (VCPS-GATE-050, independence.md SS3); null for Gates 1/2/3/6.

supersedes_ref.description: Link to the prior evaluation of the same change/gate this one supersedes, if any (VCPS-GATE-031).
